app.title: Video Dubber
steps.label: Steps
tpl.uploadHint: Pick a winning ad (MP4/MOV, up to 1 GB). Do this once per video; next time pick it from the list.
tpl.name: Name
tpl.previewHint: The red box marks the old text. Click “Preview” to see the new caption at this moment (first time takes 10–20s to remove old text).
tpl.captionsHint: Each row: start second · end second · original text. Caption 1 is the hook, replaced by each text line in step 3.
tpl.voiceHint: Each line: start · end · words. The new voice is placed on these timestamps.
cover.title: Old caption cover
cover.hint: Pixel coordinates of the source video. The box must contain all old text; in 'text only' mode everything except the letters is kept.
audio.originalHint: Change text only, keep voice + music
audio.separateHint: Removes the original voice, keeps background music (needs separation model)
audio.music_fileHint: Use a music file you upload
langs.title: Pick languages
langs.hint: Each language can have several hooks — enter them in the next step.
tr.title: Text per language
tr.hint: Each line in “Hooks” = 1 video. E.g. 3 lines × 2 languages = 6 videos.
tr.copied: Prompt copied — paste it into Claude, then paste the reply below.
tr.filled: Translations filled in — review before running.
tr.caption: Caption
tr.syncHook: Voice line 1 reads the hook (text and voice match)
tr.tooLong: “{text}…” is 30% longer than the original — text may shrink
res.title: Results
res.fixHint: Edit the lines for {lang} and click Create videos — untick other languages to re-render only this one.
tpl.needCaption: Add at least one caption with text: click “+ Add caption” and enter start, end and the original on-screen text.
res.log: View log (send to support if the tool errors or hangs)
audio.uploaded_voiceHint: Remove original voice, keep music, use your voice file
audio.voiceFile: Voice file (MP3/WAV/M4A) — shared by all videos
cover.modeText: Remove text only, keep glow (subtle — recommended)
cover.modeBox: Blur the whole box (for static source video)
group.keepNote: Your text, style and translations are kept for the next video you upload or open. Press Reset to start over.
group.multiHint: You can pick several videos at once (hold Ctrl/⌘). They share text and translations.
group.title: {n} videos share text — click one to adjust its positions
group.add: Add videos (they take the current text)
group.samePos: Use the same text and cover position for all videos
drag.hint: Drag the blue box (new text) and the red box (old-text cover) to move them; drag the corner square to resize. Focus a box and use arrow keys to fine-tune (Shift = bigger steps). When the boxes overlap, grab the “Cover old text” label to move the red box.
drag.cap: New text box — drag or use arrow keys to move
drag.cover: Old-text cover — drag or use arrow keys to move
draft.resetHint: Clear the current text, languages and translations to start over (uploaded videos stay in the list)
draft.confirmReset: Clear the current text, languages and translations and start over? Uploaded videos stay in the “Existing videos” list.
models.need: The “Separate music…” modes need the AI separation + offline voice models (~420 MB, one-time download, needs Internet). This copy doesn't have them yet.
models.progress: Downloading {name}: {done}/{total} MB — keep the tool open, options unlock when done.
models.libs: This machine is missing libraries for music separation/voice: {libs}. Click the button below — the tool installs them itself (needs Internet, a few minutes).
update.note: The tool downloads the new version, installs it and restarts itself (about 1–3 minutes). Your videos and work in progress are kept.
update.restart: Restarting the tool — this page reloads by itself, don't close it.
update.timeout: The tool didn't come back. Open it again yourself; if it still fails, download the new version from Releases.
